title: Capas de Referencia del Instituto Geográfico Nacional de Argentina
description: Official reference layers from Argentina's Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN), extracted from their WFS service and published as cloud-optimized GeoParquet. The dataset comprises 192 thematic collections covering hydrography, geomorphology and relief, transport infrastructure, political-administrative boundaries (country, province, department, municipality), settlements, vegetation, geodetic networks, coastal and maritime zones, and more across Argentina including its Antarctic sector. All layers are publicly accessible under Argentina's Public Information Access Law 27.275.
